description: Returns one public profile, found by user id or by name or @nickname: biography, place, rating, recent reviews, active offers and demands, and its pikosabe.com link. When several profiles match a name, returns the list of matches instead. Results carry no phone number: contact happens on the pikosabe.com page of the listing or profile.

country.description: Market to read: PY = Paraguay, BO = Bolivia, UY = Uruguay. Results stay within that market.

query.description: Name or @nickname, for example "Teresa" or "@juanito". Used when no user_id is known.

user_id.description: User id, as returned by search.

name: show_profile
title: Show a Piko profile
